title: Software Engineer II (Full-Stack) - Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.</p> <p>Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities.</p> <p>This role is based in our London office with a <strong>hybrid</strong> setup, typically 3 days in the office.</p> <p>Get to know our<a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/software-engineering-at-deliveroo/"> Engineering</a> team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do?</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.</p> <p><strong>Technical Execution:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.</li> <li>You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration & Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.</li> <li>You'll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical / implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team.</li> <li>You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Expectations:</strong></p> <p>We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas.</p> <ul> <li>Strong fullstack experience — comfortable working across backend (Go, or similar) and web frontend (React/TypeScript) to unblock delivery end-to-end</li> <li>Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)</li> <li>Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief/RFC through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding</li> <li>Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches</li> <li>Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></p> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>🔧 <strong>Solve meaningful problems at real scale</strong> Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</li> <li>🌱 <strong>See your impact, fast</strong> Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</li> <li>🧠 <strong>Grow through challenge and ownership</strong> Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</li> <li>🌎 <strong>A culture built for builders</strong> High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</li> <li>💰 <strong>Share in the success you help create</strong> Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2><strong>Role outline</strong></h2> <p>Proposed title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations</p> <p>Location: London Head Office (The River Building) - Hybrid working (60% in Head Office)</p> <p>Mission: Ensure a reliable and scalable courier network across EMEA markets by continuously optimising the end-to-end lifecycle experience. You will translate data-driven insights into practical actions that strengthen engagement, performance, and long-term participation. Your role is to maintain the right balance of supply to meet changing operational and customer demand across markets.</p> <p>Core interfaces: EMEA Dasher & Logistics Operations (Regional Operations, Planning & Performance, Content & Engagement), Product, Data Science, Analytics Engineering as needed.</p> <h2><strong>Job Description </strong><strong>(ready to paste into Greenhouse)</strong></h2> <h3>The team</h3> <p>The EMEA Strategy & Operations team is responsible for ensuring our Dasher network remains stable, engaged, and responsive across multiple markets. We combine data insights, operational strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our network remains healthy, resilient, and ready to scale.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping the performance and stability of our courier network across multiple markets. You will be accountable for maintaining a healthy and responsive supply base throughout the lifecycle, ensuring it aligns with business and customer needs.</p> <p> </p> <p>You will operate as a hands-on operator, executing upon team initiatives and driving continuous improvement. Working closely with cross-functional partners across operations, product, analytics, and other central teams, you will translate data and insights into scalable processes and frameworks. </p> <p> </p> <p>Requirements</p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering operational improvements through complex data analysis and modelling in fast-paced environments. title: Software Engineer, Prime
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Join us in building the future of finance.</h2> <p>Our mission is to democratize finance for all. <a href="https://www.cerulli.com/press-releases/cerulli-anticipates-124-trillion-in-wealth-will-transfer-through-2048" target="_blank">An estimated $124 trillion of assets</a> will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.</p></div><h2>About the team + role</h2> <p>We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.<strong> </strong>We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. </p> <p>The <strong>Prime team's</strong> mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. title: Senior Agent Harness Engineer
description: About us: Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes. We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making. Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. About the team We’re hiring AI engineers to help us transform research outcomes in biomedical sciences. We utilise generative AI and agents to help scientists find novel connections and insights from biomedical literature and datasets. Delivering a faster research experience is not just a matter of picking the latest LLM model. Getting accurate, scientifically relevant, trustworthy and meaningful results relies on building trust with our users that comes from integrating proper levels of guardrails, biomedical curation, consistent update cycles and robust deployment practices that make our platform a one-stop shop for a researcher’s needs. We’re looking for AI engineers who will champion this cause and help us apply AI to transform the way biomedical professionals carry out their research and day-to-day exploration. What you’ll be doing Design and implement AI agents end-to-end, from the first idea to deployment and monitoring, balancing cutting-edge techniques with pragmatism to deliver measurable impact. Apply strong software engineering principles, such as modularity, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and observability, to ensure AI systems are reliable, maintainable, production-ready and can be readily adapted to future developments. Choose the right approach for the problem at hand, evaluating different models, prompts, tools and agent designs to balance trade-offs between speed, cost, complexity, interpretability, and performance. Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to scope work, align on success metrics, and incrementally ship improvements in user-facing features powered by AI. Document system architectures and decision rationale early and clearly, enabling alignment across teams and accelerating onboarding and iteration. Champion model and data quality, including robust evaluation, hallucination checks, and real-world performance tracking. Mentor junior AI engineers and cross-functional teammates, sharing best practices in modelling, coding, maintaining and integrating product features, and helping grow a high-trust, high-performance team culture. Stay up-to-date with emerging research and tools, distilling key insights and bringing back relevant innovations to elevate team capabilities and product opportunities. Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, through company-wide Slack channels, Show and Tell presentations and technical deep-dives. What experience you’ll need to be successful A master's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 5+ years of experience building software in production environments, including LLM-based systems, with ownership of key lifecycle stages: design, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Proficiency in Python and modern agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, with experience integrating LLMs into applications. A solid understanding of LLMs and agents, including topics such as tool use, context management, prompt engineering and evals. Strong software engineering foundations such as version control, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, containerization plus a mindset of building for reliability and scale. Experience working in product-focused teams, collaborating with designers, engineers, and PMs, to scope and ship AI features iteratively Ability to reason about system behaviour end-to-end, including model performance, latency, and observability, and how these impact user experience. Clear, structured communicator, comfortable documenting and defending architectural decisions and engaging in thoughtful technical debate. Not required, but it’s a plus if you also have: Experience with LLMOps frameworks and best practices A PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. A background or work experience in life-sciences, health-tech, or other data-intensive domains Benefits 💰 Competitive compensation package 🩺 Private medical & dental insurance 📔 Life insurance (4 x salary) 🤓 Personal development budget 🧘 Individual wellbeing budget 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 🥳 Your birthday off! 🚀 Potential to have real impact and accelerated career growth as a member of an international team that's building a transformative AI product. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2><strong>The deadline for applying to this role is Wednesday 25th November 2026, end of day (UK Time).</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As the models we test get more capable and the environments we run them in get more sensitive, we have to continue to be able to run evaluations of highly capable models under proper control and ensure that it remains governed well. Building that governance and keeping it fast is what lets AISI keep pace with the work in front of it.<br><br>The Security Engineering team keeps AISI's research platform, evaluation environments, and sensitive data secure, and runs the governance, risk, and compliance around them. We harden the environments evaluations run in, detect and respond to threats, and build the controls that let evaluations of highly capable models proceed safely. We work with research teams across AISI, with partners in frontier AI companies and government.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Rigorous safety governance and fast-moving research aren't mutually exclusive. AISI research involves working with highly capable AI models, often before they have been released to the public and often with lowered safeguards, to understand their true capabilities. That work has to be properly controlled, and someone has to build the processes and systems that help us make the call that it's safe to run without becoming a bottleneck. We're hiring a Technical Programme Manager in Security Engineering to own the AISI-wide governance mechanism that oversees these safety judgements, the controls research teams work under, and every edge case and escalation in between. You'll work with the team's engineers and the researchers whose work this governs.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll own:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>AISI-wide Governance Mechanism that oversees safety. </strong>Own the process, make clear what it approves and how, help people work through their requirements proactively, and keep decisions well-evidenced and moving.</li> <li><strong>The research/control interface. </strong>You'll own how research teams meet the security controls that apply to their work, and the defined path for handling the exceptions.</li> <li><strong>Programme architecture and delivery. </strong>You'll track the team's work and spot problems early, with enough visibility to stay in control.</li> <li><strong>Cross-government governance engagement. </strong>You'll represent AISI on governance and risk with partners across government, including the Cabinet Office, building the relationships, and turning departmental policy into AISI process.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we're looking for</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential experience:</strong></h3> <p>You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:</p> <ul> <li><strong>A track record with technical colleagues. </strong>You've delivered technical programmes somewhere similarly ambiguous. You can scope and structure an open-ended goal. Technical teams trust you.</li> <li><strong>Comfort at the frontier of AI. </strong>You don't have to be an ML researcher, but you need to hold your own in constant conversation with technical staff about the work, the strategy, and the risks. You should have a view on what's hard, what's speculative, what's blocked, and what "good" looks like.</li> <li><strong>High agency and ownership.</strong> You own outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>Strong prioritisation under pressure. </strong>You can tell what actually matters day to day and quarter to quarter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></h3> <p>Strong candidates may also have:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in security, risk, or GRC. A technical background with a genuine interest in security is ideal but not required.</li> <li>Fluency in, or appetite for, modern productivity tools (coding agents, Linear, Slack) and AI tools as part of daily work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2><strong>The deadline for applying to this role is Tuesday 8th December, </strong><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">end of day, anywhere on Earth</span></span></strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Red Team conducts cutting-edge research to identify, evaluate and stress test vulnerabilities in frontier AI systems, sharing our findings directly with leading AI companies, UK officials and allied governments. Our work shapes how the most powerful AI systems are deployed - you can read about it in the <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/24/technology/uk-ai-safety-institute.html">The New York Times</a>, <a href="https://www.economist.com/britain/2026/02/19/britain-is-the-closest-the-world-has-to-an-ai-safety-inspector">The Economist,</a> and <a href="https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2026/04/22/32-year-old-wunderkind-preparing-britain-ai-attack/">The Telegraph</a>. Demand for this work is growing faster than we can currently meet - we're scaling to address that gap. </p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The Red Team’s work is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h4> </h4> <h3><strong>Note: </strong>We are currently recruiting for multiple positions, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.</h3> <h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Field Engineering, you are an experienced problem solver and technical leader who stays anchored to impact. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, lead technical initiatives, and excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to embed cutting-edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.</p> <p>You’ve shipped ML systems end-to-end and at scale: you design, build and test reliable, scalable ML data pipelines; you know how to explore and manipulate 3D point-cloud and mesh data to enable geometry-aware modelling; you select the right libraries, frameworks and tools and make pragmatic product decisions that set Field Engineering up for success. Working at the intersection of data science and software engineering, you translate R&D and project outputs into reusable libraries, tooling and products.</p> <p>With at least 3 years industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you're ready to not only execute but also lead and mentor others. You're truly excited about taking ownership of complex work streams and guiding teams to success, while continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.</p> <p> </p> <h2>This Role </h2> <p>As a Senior MLE, you'll work closely with our Data Scientists, Simulation Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving. You will iterate with customers and use your influence to drive decisions around reliable deployment with measurable outcomes.</p> <p>You'll:</p> <ul> <li>Own the deployment of ML models and engineering surrogates (e.g., deep learning on CAE/CFD/FEA data, time‑series forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization & control) to customer production environments.</li> <li>Communicate results and trade‑offs to senior stakeholders; steer roadmaps and influence product direction with evidence.</li> <li>Lead scoping and architecture design for data/ML systems; define success metrics, delivery plans and quality bars.</li> <li>Excel at building robust and scalable ML systems, training and inference pipelines and APIs, running both on cloud and on-prem environments. The tech stack you will use for this includes: Python, PyTorch, Pandas, fastAPI, Scipy, Kubeflow, among others.</li> <li>Mentor and develop engineers and data scientists; provide technical direction and clear, calm decision‑making under pressure.</li> <li>Travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an <strong>average of 3-4 weeks per quarter</strong>, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.</li> <li>Own the scoping of new projects and work-streams with existing customers and taking part in bringing new customers to PhysicsX.</li> </ul> <p>As a senior member of the team, you’ll significantly influence our technical direction and will be involved in shaping future solutions and products, while developing your skills as a technical leader.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Our Field Engineering teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - <a href="https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world">read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!</a></strong><a href="https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world"> </a></h2> <p>We operate on a hybrid working model with 3 days in our Shoreditch office. </p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p><strong>Build what actually matters</strong></p> <p>Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.</p> <p><strong>Learn alongside exceptional people</strong></p> <p>Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.</p> <p><strong>Influence over hierarchy</strong></p> <p>We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.</p> <p><strong>Sustainable pace, long-term ambition</strong></p> <p>Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our Shoreditch office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.</p> <p><strong>And it doesn’t stop there …</strong></p> <p>🚀 <strong>Equity options</strong> - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.</p> <p>🏦 <strong>10% employer pension contribution</strong> - because investing in future matters.</p> <p>🍽️ <strong>Free office lunches</strong> - to keep you energised and focused.</p> <p>👶 <strong>Enhanced parental leave</strong> - 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.</p> <p>🍼 <strong>YellowNest nursery scheme</strong> - to help working parents manage childcare costs.</p> <p><strong>☀️ 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays)</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>- because taking time to rest matters.</p> <p>🏥 <strong>Private medical insurance</strong> - 100% employee cover, giving you complete peace of mind.</p> <p>💪 <strong>Wellhub Subscription</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>- gain access to thousands of gyms, classes and wellness apps, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.</p> <p>👀 <strong>Eye tests</strong> - because good work depends on good health.</p> <p>📈 <strong>Personal development</strong> - dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.</p> <p>💛 <strong>Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)</strong> - confidential wellbeing support, available whenever you need it.</p> <p>🚲 <strong>Bike2Work scheme and</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>🚆 <strong>Season ticket loan</strong> - to make getting to work easier and greener.</p> <p>🚗 <strong>Octopus EV salary sacrifice</strong> - for a simpler, more sustainable way to drive electric.</p> <p><em>🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> </div> <div>We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics. </div> <div> </div> <div>We collect diversity and inclusion data solely for the purpose of monitoring the effectiveness of our equal opportunities policies and ensuring compliance with employment and equality legislation. This information is confidential, used only in aggregate form, and will not influence the outcome of your application. </div> <div> <div class="body body__secondary"> <div id="question_7460024101-description" class="question-description"></div> </div> </div> <div> <div class="select"> </div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Garment Technologist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior Garment Technologist</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Garment Technologist</strong> to join the founding team of Quince’s new London Design Atelier. In this role, you will own the technical execution, fit, construction, and consistency of ready-to-wear products across Women’s and Men’s, partnering closely with Design, Pattern Cutting, Product Development, Sourcing, Quality, and external manufacturing partners.</p> <p>This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of creative design and product execution. title: Developer Experience Engineer - AI SDLC
description: We Are Sparta Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders. Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has. We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done. Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. The role You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows. AI has changed how code gets written, reviewed, and tested, and the tooling has not caught up. Your job is to make an engineer with Claude Code, a good harness and a fast pipeline several times more effective, and to prove it with data, not anecdotes. What you will do Own the AI development toolchain. Set up and evolve Claude Code and other development agents across engineering: shared skills, MCP servers, repo context, and guardrails, so agents work well in our codebase out of the box. Build agents into the lifecycle. Automate the work around the code: AI-assisted code review, test generation, dependency upgrades, migrations and incident triage, with humans in the loop where it matters. Make CI/CD fast and boring. Own build, test and release pipelines across the Nx monorepo: caching, affected-only builds, preview environments and safe, frequent deploys to AWS. Build the guardrails for everyone who builds. Anyone can build now, including product, design, data and domain experts working with agents. Create the tooling that makes it safe for them to contribute code: automated quality gates, code ownership and review rules, preview environments, policy checks and agent evals in the pipeline, so good changes ship fast and risky ones are caught early. Testing strategy sits inside this: define what we test at each level and make the right tests cheap to write. Keep it secure. Secrets, permissions and sandboxing for agents that read code and run commands, and supply-chain checks in the pipeline. Raise the bar for everyone. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering. What you bring Extensive experience as a hands-on software engineer, with recent focus on developer experience, platform or build and release engineering. You have rolled out AI coding tools to a team and made them stick: you know where agents help, where they fail and how to set them up for a real codebase. You lead without needing authority: you treat engineers as customers, listen first, and win adoption with tools people want to use. Nice to have Built Claude Code skills, plugins or MCP servers, or extended another agent harness. Deep CI/CD experience: you have designed pipelines for a monorepo, cut build and test times, and run safe, frequent releases. Infrastructure as code and container platforms. Experience defining or running engineering metrics. Our stack for this team Claude Ecosystem · Nx monorepo · GitHub · AWS · TypeScript · Python · Kotlin Why Join Sparta? At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded. • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company • $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment • Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale • Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence • Top-tier tools and technology to support your success What's the Culture Like at Sparta? At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers. The Sparta Code Understanding is non-negotiable Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning. The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed. Ask for forgiveness, not for permission Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not. 90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned. Fall in love with the problem The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to. Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working. It's your fault. Lucky you. If it's on you, it's in your control. True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency. Conflict is a gift Honesty is an expression of care. Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it. Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law. title: Security Engineer
description: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich. You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto . About the role Our partners trust us with their most valuable secrets: unpublished targets, novel molecules and years of proprietary assay data. Your job is to make sure that trust is well placed, everywhere our platform runs: our own cloud, dedicated single-tenant environments, and partners' own AWS and Google Cloud accounts. You will be a founding engineer on our security team, part of the Platform team in Core Engineering, shaping the security program with our CTO, who leads it today. You will work with every engineering team at Boltz, and you will sit across the table from the security leaders of the world's largest pharma companies. We want security to be the reason a partner says yes faster, not the reason a deal stalls. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who would rather fix a control in code than write a document about it, and who can explain risk clearly to a pharma CISO. What you'll do Make secure the default: build guardrails into our Terraform, Kubernetes and CI/CD so every new cluster, environment and partner deployment inherits the right boundaries from day one. Protect what matters most: keep partner data isolated across tenants and deployments, protect our model weights, and make sure the agents acting on scientists' behalf can only do what they should. Make the secure path the easy path: identity, secrets, service-to-service authentication and supply-chain controls that engineers actually want to use. See and stop threats: logging, detection and incident response across AWS and GCP, with exercises that keep us sharp. Find weaknesses first: threat-model new features before they ship, run penetration tests, and attack our own agents and APIs before anyone else does. Turn trust into an advantage: lead security reviews with partners' security teams, translate their requirements into engineering work early, and run our SOC 2 Type II program and the frameworks partners ask for next (e.g. ISO 27001) with evidence generated by our systems, not by screenshots. Secure the company: identity, device management, access reviews and security awareness for a small, highly technical team. This role is not a compliance-only (GRC) or SOC analyst role. Most of your time goes into engineering; compliance should be a by-product of controls that actually work. About you Minimum Requirements 4+ years of security engineering experience in cloud-native SaaS or infrastructure companies. Deep, hands-on cloud security experience on AWS or Google Cloud: IAM and multi-account or multi-project organizations, network security, encryption and key management, audit logging and threat detection. Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and enough hands-on engineering to ship security improvements yourself. Application security experience: threat modeling, secure code review, authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth/OIDC, MFA), web and API vulnerabilities. Experience owning a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 program through an external audit, or building the controls one depends on. Practical incident response experience. Low ego, high ownership, and pragmatic trade-offs between risk and speed; clear with engineers, leadership and partners' security teams alike. Preferred Requirements Kubernetes and container security (network policy, admission control, workload identity, image signing). Security for ML or LLM systems: agent tool access, prompt injection, model and training-data protection. Experience as an early or founding security hire at a startup. Securing deployments in customer-controlled, multi-cloud or regulated environments. Exposure to life-sciences or pharma security and data-protection expectations (e.g. GDPR). description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel </strong>to<strong> </strong>lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team of 15-20 or more qualified lawyers, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Direct experience of public company governance — listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls — gained either as counsel inside a listed company or on a listing process.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO from preparation to admission.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. description: Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can. Senior AI Engineer - Security Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Technology adoption. We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today's workforce. Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they've learned to improve productivity and measurable performance. In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe's first EdTech double unicorn. But we aren't stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We're building a world where tech skills unlock people's potential and output. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. The Agentic Work Environment team The Agentic Work Environment (AWE) owns the environment everyone at Multiverse works in, wherever they are in the world. That covers the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day, the platform our product is built and run on, and the identity and access that decide who, or which agent, can do what across all of it. Product teams own what they build; we own the ground it stands on, the path it takes to production, and the baseline standards it meets on the way. Our mission is to make the safe way the fast way for every colleague and the agents they put to work. For a security-minded AI engineer, that remit runs in two directions. In the product platform, you build security into the path itself: review agents that check every change against our baseline standards, one identity for customers, staff and agents, and detection and response through our SIEM and SOAR, so nobody, person or agent, has to remember to be secure. In the workplace, you secure the devices, tools and accounts colleagues around the world rely on. As more of them put agents to work, whatever their job title, you make sure every agent has its own identity, a named owner, scoped access and evals, so autonomy is earned on evidence rather than granted on trust. What your day-to-day will look like Every day will be different, but you can expect it to include: Build security into the path to production. You turn our baseline standards into checks that run on every change: policy as code, review agents that check each change against the baseline and a team's own standards, and gates matched to the risk of what's changing. Staying on the path should meet the security requirements without any extra work. Secure the agents we and our colleagues build. You threat-model agent systems end to end, from prompt injection and tool misuse to data leaking through context and retrieval, and design the controls that stop it: scoped tool permissions, permission-aware retrieval, sandboxing, and human approval where the risk calls for it. Give every agent an identity. You build the identity and access layer for agents. Each one has its own identity, a named owner, least-privilege access that is reviewed and can be revoked at once, and a full record of what it did. Build detection and response with agents. You write detections and automated responses on our SIEM and SOAR, and build agents that triage alerts, gather context and carry out bounded, reversible responses, so people spend their time on the cases that need judgement. Secure the workplace, worldwide. You apply the same approach to the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day: automated controls rather than manual checklists, and access that is granted and removed as people join, move and leave. Prove it holds with security evals. You build eval pipelines and red-team exercises that show whether our agents and controls stand up to attack, and produce compliance evidence as a by-product of the work rather than as screenshots for an auditor. Influence technical direction. You have opinions about how things should be built, and you back them up with evidence. You contribute to architectural decisions, push back when the team is heading in the wrong direction, and propose better approaches. What We Are Looking For Security Engineering: You have built security into systems rather than reviewed it after the fact, across some mix of application and cloud security, identity and access, and detection and response. You understand how AI systems get attacked, through prompt injection, tool misuse and data leaking through context, and you design controls that make the secure option the easy one for the people using them Production AI Agent Engineering: You have shipped AI systems that serve real users at scale. You understand the engineering challenges that make agent systems different from conventional software, including context management, model selection and routing, cost engineering, tool use and agent augmentation, and evaluation Product mindset: Your natural instinct is to identify the real user pain, understand their requirements and build pragmatic, high-impact solutions. You test, learn and iterate fast, and are comfortable executing under high ambiguity Full-Stack Delivery: You work across the stack: LLM integration, backend services, data pipelines, and enough frontend to ship end to end Communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business colleagues. You proactively engage the people around your work, and bring them along with you on the journey Fluent in AI-assisted development and can mentor others to do it well Benefits Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days). Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub. Equity for all : we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options. Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme. Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers. Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences. A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals. A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture. Founded in 2000, the firm has offices in London, New York, Hong Kong and Abu Dhabi, and currently manages $9 billion in assets across five funds. Pharo trades foreign exchange, sovereign and corporate credit, local market interest rates, commodities, and their derivatives. We trade in over 70 countries across Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Latin America as well as developed markets. Our investment approach combines macroeconomic fundamental research and quantitative analysis.</p> <p>Pharo employs a diverse, dynamic team of 140 professionals representing over 20 nationalities and 30 languages. We have a strong corporate culture anchored in core values such as collaborative spirit, creativity, and respect. We are passionate about what we do and are committed to attracting the best and brightest talent.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity to join a market leader and contribute to our continued success.</p> <p><strong><u>Job description:</u></strong></p> <p>We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our technology team in London. This role helps build and maintain the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and monitoring that our trading, research, and operations systems run on. It is a hands-on position with a broad remit, offering real ownership and visible impact on how the business runs.</p> <p>The role sits alongside software developers, data engineers, and infrastructure staff, with support from senior engineers as the successful candidate develops. We are looking for someone curious and methodical, who enjoys understanding how systems fit together and takes pride in making things reliable and repeatable rather than merely working.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities will include: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for internal applications, working with developers to make releases faster, safer, and more automated.</li> <li>Support day-to-day requests from development teams, helping developers debug build, deployment and environment issues.</li> <li>Support and extend our cloud and on-premise infrastructure, including provisioning environments and managing configuration through infrastructure-as-code.</li> <li>Help operate monitoring, alerting, and logging so that issues are caught before they affect users, and contribute to investigating and resolving incidents when they occur.</li> <li>Write scripts and small tools to automate manual and repetitive operational tasks.</li> <li>Contribute to improving software delivery practices across the technology team.</li> <li>Participate in an on-call rotation, providing out of hours support for DevOps related issues impacting critical services.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Required qualities and skills:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering role, including internships and placements.</li> <li>Experience with Git and standard branching and code review workflows.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD tooling, particularly GitHub Actions.</li> <li>Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc).</li> <li>Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly Terraform.</li> <li>Experience working with a major cloud platform (Azure, GCP, AWS).</li> <li>Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing, firewalls).</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues to colleagues from non-technical teams.</li> <li>Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell, or Bash.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows Server administration.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, or Sentry.</li> <li>Some SQL and exposure to relational databases, particularly SQL Server.</li> <li>Awareness of security and compliance considerations in a regulated financial services setting.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Work status and location:</u></strong></p> <p>Full time in London</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our global Recruiting team. In this role, you will focus on hiring engineers across our Trading Technology (live trading environment) and Research & Development (enabling research) engineering teams. You will partner directly with hiring managers who have incredibly high standards, helping them navigate a competitive talent landscape. You will engage with deeply technical candidates, and manage the end-to-end hiring process for a variety of technical roles within HRT’s engineering ecosystem. </p> <p>HRT is one of the top quantitative trading firms in the world. We combine world-class engineering and scientific rigor with a low-ego, collaborative culture. Our people and our compute capabilities are our two most important differentiators, and that is where we are investing the most. We want recruiters who bring a unique perspective and curiosity, who can challenge the status quo of how to find the brilliant yet humble technical talent that make HRT so special. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner directly with engineering leadership on recruitment strategy, and be a proactive and consultative strategic partner to hiring managers</li> <li>Manage the end-to-end hiring pipelines of engineering roles from first outreach through offer acceptance, including navigating complex offer negotiations</li> <li>Provide a high-touch, white-glove candidate experience across both opportunistic roles and high-volume pipelines</li> <li>Apply an engineering mindset to your recruitment approach, continuously leveraging recruiting data & analytics to identify inefficiencies and iterate on your process</li> <li>Build relationships with external recruitment agencies to generate high-quality candidate flow for your roles</li> <li>Conduct market research and talent mapping projects to identify top technical talent, uncover candidate trends, and complete competitor analyses</li> <li>Attract passive candidates using creative sourcing methods (open-source community involvement, network building, direct outreach, referrals) to build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of full life cycle technical recruiting experience </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree </li> <li>Proven success recruiting in specialized technical title: Software Engineer - Distributed Compute
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is one of the top algorithmic trading companies in the world. Our research cluster is the backbone of our success; it’s where all of our trading strategies are generated.</p> <p>We use a large, customized research environment with highly advanced CPU and GPU compute, storage, and networking technology. Our team thinks about the entire software stack, from the user-level API to optimizing performance out of low-level caching. We deal with everything from the theoretical, like fair resource scheduling, to the concrete, like optimizing a trader’s new program run-time performance. </p> <p>As a distributed compute engineer in a user-facing environment, you’ll develop and improve on technical solutions that make research as easy and efficient as possible. You’ll work everyday with both talented quantitative traders and software engineers across all trading teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure HRT’s research environment is best in class, with a focus on user workloads</li> <ul> <li>Maintain and improve resource scheduling, data caching, and job monitoring to make research as easy, fast, and efficient as possible, using both in-house and open source solutions</li> <li>Optimize workloads at the user level to speed up user iteration speed</li> <li>Tune workloads at the infrastructure level to make them more resource-efficient</li> <li>Share metrics and real-time information with users to give insight into workload behavior</li> <li>Sit down with users to understand their specific technical needs</li> </ul> <li>Contribute individually and through leadership and coordination of the above</li> <li>Set technical direction for the platform and take holistic ownership of the software infrastructure that supports Algo research</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Strong C++ expertise (daily use preferred)</li> <li>Python familiarity preferred</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with quantitative researchers and traders to understand their needs</li> <li>Great communication capabilities</li> <li>Superior design, debugging, and problem solving skills</li> <li>Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). title: Software Engineer – C++
description:
<p>At Hudson River Trading (HRT), C++ is at the center of our live trading systems and research infrastructure. Our C++ engineers build the highly performant, fault-tolerant systems that power trading across global markets. HRT’s distributed system is on the Pareto frontier of latency and throughput, giving you limitless opportunity to leverage your deep knowledge of C++, OS internals, CPU architecture, and networking hardware and protocols. You’ll work side-by-side with researchers, traders, and hardware specialists, implementing solutions where every microsecond matters.</p> <p>Our bottom-up approach to projects and our highly collaborative environment empower talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve complex problems in a fast-paced, highly competitive industry, surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>C++ Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include: </p> <ul> <li>Develop and optimize infrastructure for market data, order entry and execution logic, spanning tens of asset classes including options, equities, futures, crypto, and title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  </p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.</li> <li>Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.</li> <li>Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.</li> <li>Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.</li> <li>Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.</li> <li>Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.</li> <li>Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.</li> <li>Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.</li> <li>Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.</li> <li>Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.</li> <li>Previous experience at a top-tier finance <em>or</em> technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.</li> <li>Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have <em>real</em> hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.</li> <li>Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)</li> <li>Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.</li> <li>Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT. </li> <li>Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill. </li> <li>If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
