title: Enterprise Sales Leader
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals. To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win: DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance. Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics. Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal. Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow. SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong. Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen. Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins. BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution. Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals. Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy. PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals. 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection. 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive. 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals. 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes. 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback. 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum. 🇬🇧 Location: You're based in the UK, Ireland or a European country where we hire (not France, Italy, Sweden, Switzerland or Romania), and happy to travel regularly to meet clients across the Nordics, Benelux, the Middle East and Africa. 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English. 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions. 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion. Nice-to-haves Additional languages: You're fluent in a regional language (e.g. Dutch, Arabic, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish). 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories. 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down. 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution. Why join us? You’ll take a team of Enterprise AEs and turn it into a repeatable engine, in one of the fastest-growing open-source companies in Europe. The playbooks you build and the people you hire will shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest technical organizations. You’ll work directly with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product, so your voice carries well beyond your own team. n8n is a remote-first company with a passionate community of builders, a culture of autonomy and experimentation, and a very high bar for talent. If you want to build something that lasts while the company scales, apply now and help us make n8n the default way enterprises automate. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. title: Associate, Finance Analytics
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Key Responsibilities: Communication & Stakeholder Management: Act as the vital bridge between technical data architecture and business-focused enterprise treasury operations, translating complex data findings into clear, non-technical insights. Proactively communicate with cross-regional teams (finance, engineering, and global treasury) across multiple time zones, ensuring alignment on data definitions, reporting requirements, and project timelines. Draft clear, concise documentation for data pipelines, dashboard usage, and reporting metrics to ensure global teams can easily understand and leverage your tools. Present analytical findings and AI/ML capabilities confidently to both the Manager and broader global stakeholders. Data Modeling & Technical Execution: Take technical requirements translated by the Manager and develop robust data pipelines and models to support treasury operations. Extract, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) complex datasets using modern tech stacks including dbt , Google BigQuery , and Snowflake . Ensure data architecture is scalable, reliable, and optimized for rapid querying and analysis. Reporting, BI & Visualization: Design, build, and maintain automated, user-friendly treasury dashboards and reports using Looker/Tableau/Power BI (or similar tools). Ensure all reports are highly accurate, timely, and aligned with broader business OKRs. Uncover and visualize key trends across all treasury domains to support senior stakeholders. AI & Advanced Analytics Initiatives: Explore and implement AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to improve treasury insights. Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new tools and methodologies to keep the team’s tech stack at the cutting edge. Qualifications: Education : Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field (Not Mandatory). Experience : 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence, preferably within a fintech, banking, payments, or financial services company. Proven track record of working collaboratively and communicating effectively in distributed or cross-regional teams. Technical Skills : Advanced proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehousing (specifically BigQuery and Snowflake ). Hands-on experience with data transformation tools ( dbt ). Strong expertise in building dashboards and visualizations in Looker . Bonus : Practical experience or strong familiarity with integrating AI/ML models or leveraging Python/R for predictive analytics. Key Competencies: Exceptional Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex, technical data into clear narratives for diverse, global audiences. Technical Agility: Deep understanding of the modern big data tech stack with an appetite for adopting new technologies, particularly in the AI space. Collaboration & Teamwork: Thrives in a globally distributed environment, working seamlessly with diverse teams across borders and cultures. Analytical Problem-Solving: Highly skilled at diving into complex, messy data to extract clean, reliable, and actionable insights. Execution-Oriented: Ability to take high-level objectives and technical tasks delegated by the Manager and deliver scalable solutions efficiently. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. Correctness matters on every transaction, and small changes in availability, latency or routing quality show up directly in our merchants' approval rates and revenue. This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets on the authorisation path, failure domains and blast radius, consistency and idempotency across regions, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock. You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously. How you'll make an impact Own the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude Design for resilience from first principles - redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery - so that partial failures never become customer-facing outages Set and defend the non-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives Lead the hardest technical decisions end to end, from problem framing and design review through to production rollout, migration and decommissioning of what came before Drive operational excellence by improving observability, alerting, capacity planning, load and chaos testing, and incident response, and by closing the loop on the root causes you find Raise the engineering bar across teams through design reviews, code review, pairing and mentorship, growing the senior engineers around you Partner with product, platform and other engineering teams to sequence delivery, remove blockers and keep multi-team programmes aligned on a single technical direction Make pragmatic build-versus-buy and refactor-versus-rewrite calls, and communicate the reasoning and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and senior leadership You'll have the judgement to know when something needs more attention and when it's ready to go. Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand. Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both. You care about the little details and know how to make a brand feel brilliant across every touchpoint. You move fast and get stuff done. You've worked in fast-paced environments, ideally startups, and know how to balance speed with quality. You're pragmatic, comfortable juggling competing priorities and don't need everything perfectly mapped out before getting started. You're confident picking up an established brand. You don't need to rebuild things from first principles to make an impact. You can get up to speed quickly, understand what's working and find ways to make it even better. You enjoy working closely with Marketing, Product Designers and engineers, sharing work early, taking feedback on board and sweating the details to make sure the finished thing is as good as it can be. You're organised and comfortable with ambiguity. Startups can (occasionally!) be chaotic. You've covered a role on an FTC or contract basis before and know how to get productive fast. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations. We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you. The Role This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers. Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter. AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace. Key Responsibilities Backend Engineering Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling. Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review. Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis. Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it. Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it remains readable, testable, maintainable, and suitable for new product requirements. Quality, Reliability, and Operations Write automated tests at the appropriate level and integrate them into CI/CD so changes can be released with clear evidence of quality. Instrument services with logs, metrics, traces, and alerts that make production behaviour and failures easy to understand. Diagnose and resolve production incidents across services, databases, queues, integrations, and infrastructure. Design for security, resilience, performance, and data integrity across business-critical workflows. Agentic and Spec-Driven Development Partner with product managers, frontend engineers, and quality engineers to turn agreed product behaviour into implementation-ready technical solution designs covering assumptions, alternatives, service interactions, data and schema changes, failure modes, security, observability, rollout, rollback, and tests. Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, review, and document code within clear technical constraints. Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and fit with Plentific's architecture. Break specifications into small, reviewable changes and validate each change against its intended behaviour before release. Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable patterns, review checklists, examples, and concise documentation. Delivery and Collaboration Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers from problem framing through release and production operation. Surface technical risks and trade-offs early, and propose pragmatic changes to scope, design, or delivery plans. Review code and technical designs, setting a high bar while giving feedback that helps other engineers improve. Coach mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, debugging, and design discussion. Requirements Expert-level Python and Django, with strong object-oriented design and software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of API design, service-oriented architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing. Expert-level relational data modelling, including the ability to produce clear ERDs, define entities, relationships, constraints, and ownership, and design PostgreSQL schemas that balance correctness, performance, and safe evolution. Demonstrable ability to turn incomplete product requirements into clear technical solution designs for complex backend changes, identifying assumptions and resolving ambiguity with product and engineering colleagues through concise written analysis and appropriate architecture, sequence, data-flow, and entity-relationship diagrams. Sound judgement around automated testing, observability, production reliability, security, and data integrity. Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review. Demonstrable ability to review technical designs and code, explain trade-offs, and coach less-experienced engineers. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and delivery risks in plain English. Pragmatic delivery judgement, balancing immediate product needs with the maintainability and scalability of a long-lived platform. High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude. Experience and Qualifications 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial commercial experience in Python and Django. Experience building and operating Django-based services in production on AWS and Kubernetes. Experience with Django REST Framework or FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and CI/CD pipelines. Track record of designing and safely evolving complex relational data models in a large, long-lived production codebase, using ERDs and written technical designs to align engineers and stakeholders while preserving design quality, testability, maintainability, and safe evolution. Experience working in cross-functional product teams with shared ownership of customer outcomes and production operation. Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework. title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. Senior Total Rewards Partner, Total Rewards How you'll make impact As Airwallex scales globally and prepares for its next stage of growth, you’ll own and evolve the Total Rewards agenda across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking, equity governance and pay transparency. Own and evolve global compensation frameworks, salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, compensation cycles and financial models that support hiring, retention, executive decision-making and international expansion. Build and improve job architecture and leveling frameworks that support organisational scalability, internal equity and talent mobility. Shape regional and global benefits programmes, including plan design, annual renewals, broker and insurer negotiations, benchmarking and cost optimisation, while balancing employee value, fiscal discipline and local market requirements. Hands-on benefits administration isn’t the primary focus of this role. Partner with executive leadership, People Partners and Talent Acquisition to turn complex reward data into clear recommendations, challenge decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data or regulatory requirements, and lead Total Rewards initiatives from scoping and design through implementation. Support international market expansion by developing competitive, compliant and locally relevant compensation and benefits frameworks across global markets. What we're looking for Essentials 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, ideally within high-growth technology or fintech environments. Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling global compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity structures in hyper-growth organisations. Strong expertise in compensation strategy, including market benchmarking, job and salary architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, and financial modelling. Experience designing benefits programs and leading annual renewals, including broker and insurer negotiations. Hands-on benefits administration is not a primary focus. Practical experience managing compensation planning and equity programs, leading system implementations or migrations, and working with HR technology platforms such as Workday, BambooHR, Carta, Shareworks or Pave. Advanced analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data and financial models into actionable insights and executive recommendations. Proven ability to influence and communicate Total Rewards decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, and Talent Acquisition, demonstrating sound business judgement and confidence in challenging decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data, or regulatory requirements. A builder mindset, with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and develop scalable solutions across global markets and time zones. Preferred Experience in a late-stage private, pre-IPO, or recently listed company, particularly navigating equity program transformation, strengthening rewards governance, and preparing for public-market readiness. Experience building scalable Total Rewards programs from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with end-to-end ownership and strong accountability. Experience advising C-suite and senior leadership stakeholders on compensation, benefits, equity and rewards governance. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including scenario modelling and assessment of financial implications. Experience partnering effectively across diverse cultures, functions and international teams, navigating time zones and varying local market requirements. Experience translating complex compensation, benefits and equity concepts into clear, actionable messages for business leaders, People teams and employees. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. Learn more about your team People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it. This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system. It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. title: Head of Growth Asia
description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Your job is to build, lead and scale LemFi’s business across Asia, driving sustainable growth, strong country-level ownership and regional profitability. As Head of Asia, you will own the regional strategy and commercial performance across China, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh and any new markets launched across the region. You will lead and develop Country Managers, empowering them to own their country-level P&Ls while maintaining accountability for the region’s overall financial performance, growth and profitability. You will translate LemFi’s broader business objectives into clear regional priorities, ensuring every market has a focused growth strategy, disciplined budget management and measurable commercial targets. You will oversee annual strategic planning, quarterly growth priorities and monthly execution plans, ensuring that country teams remain on track to deliver their targets and adapt quickly when performance or market conditions change. You’ll combine strategic leadership with hands-on commercial execution. One day, you might be reviewing regional P&L performance and reallocating budgets across markets; the next, coaching a Country Manager on acquisition strategy, evaluating a new market opportunity, negotiating a strategic partnership or addressing a market that is falling behind its growth targets. You will establish a high-performance operating cadence across the region, using data and commercial insight to identify opportunities, address underperformance, share best practices and allocate resources where they can generate the greatest impact. You will work closely with product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance to ensure that regional plans are supported by the right capabilities and executed effectively. You own the regional numbers, the performance of your markets and the development of your leaders. Your mission is to make Asia a major engine of sustainable growth and profitability for LemFi. What you'll build and own Regional P&L and commercial performance. Own the overall Asia regional P&L, with accountability for revenue, transfer volume, gross profit, acquisition costs, retention, operating expenditure and profitability. Translate regional objectives into market-level targets, monitor financial performance and take decisive action to close gaps and improve returns. Country leadership and accountability. Manage, coach and develop Country Managers across China, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh and future markets. Set clear expectations, establish performance standards and ensure each Country Manager has the direction, resources and accountability needed to deliver sustainable growth. Country-level P&L ownership. Empower and enable Country Managers to run their own country P&Ls, make informed commercial decisions and take ownership of their market's financial outcomes. Build their capabilities in budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, channel investment and profitability, while maintaining appropriate regional oversight and alignment. Regional growth strategy and planning. Own the regional growth strategy and oversee the development and execution of annual business plans, quarterly growth plans and monthly operating plans across all markets. Ensure plans are grounded in market opportunity, clear performance targets, realistic budgets and measurable initiatives. Review progress regularly and adjust priorities as needed. Performance management and operating cadence. Establish a consistent rhythm of business reviews across the region, including monthly performance reviews, quarterly planning and regular growth and budget calibration sessions. Track performance against targets, identify risks and opportunities early, and ensure every market has clear actions to address underperformance. Budget allocation and resource optimisation. Oversee regional marketing and growth budgets, ensuring investment is allocated to markets and channels with the strongest potential returns. Identify forecast underspend, evaluate opportunities to accelerate growth and reallocate resources where appropriate to maximise regional impact and new-user acquisition. Market expansion and new-country launches. Identify and evaluate opportunities to expand into new Asian markets. Develop market-entry strategies, assess commercial potential, define investment requirements and coordinate launch plans across product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance. Establish clear launch milestones and ensure new markets have the leadership, infrastructure and commercial plans needed to scale. Customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness. Supervise country-level acquisition strategies across paid and organic channels, partnerships, referrals, community networks and other distribution opportunities. Ensure teams optimise against measurable outcomes, including new users, customer acquisition cost, conversion, transfer volume, retention and lifetime value. Encourage experimentation and the adoption of successful approaches across markets. Strategic partnerships and distribution. Guide Country Managers in identifying, negotiating and developing strategic partnerships that accelerate acquisition and transaction growth. Support high-value regional partnerships where relevant, establish effective commercial frameworks and ensure partnerships translate into measurable business results. Pricing, unit economics and profitability. Oversee market-level pricing strategies and unit economics, ensuring each country balances competitive customer propositions with sustainable margins. Challenge investment decisions, review corridor and channel profitability, and help teams identify opportunities to improve contribution and long-term commercial performance. Market intelligence and competitive strategy. Maintain a strong understanding of customer behaviours, diaspora communities, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations and market-specific opportunities across Asia. Translate market insights into regional priorities and ensure Country Managers adapt their strategies to local customer needs. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other central teams to align regional priorities with company-wide objectives. Represent the needs of Asian markets in central planning and ensure teams have the capabilities, resources and support required to execute their growth plans. Leadership development and organisational effectiveness. Build a strong regional leadership team by developing Country Managers into commercially capable, accountable business owners. Establish clear decision-making frameworks, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency and continuous improvement. Executive reporting and strategic decision-making. Provide clear, data-led updates on regional performance, financial forecasts, growth opportunities, key risks and resource requirements. Present recommendations to senior leadership and drive decisions that support LemFi's long-term growth and profitability. Your experience An experienced regional commercial leader: 10–15 years of experience across fintech, payments, remittances, financial services or high-growth businesses, with a track record of managing substantial commercial targets and preferably multi-market P&L responsibility. A proven people leader: Experience managing senior market leaders, Country Managers or commercial teams across multiple geographies. You know how to set direction, coach leaders, build accountability and create high-performing teams. Strong P&L ownership: Demonstrated experience managing revenue, costs, budgets, forecasts and profitability. You can connect country-level commercial decisions to overall regional financial performance. A strategic growth operator: Experience developing and overseeing annual strategies, quarterly plans and monthly execution priorities. You can translate business objectives into clear plans, measurable targets and consistent delivery. Commercially and analytically sharp: Strong understanding of customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, conversion, gross profit, retention, unit economics and channel performance. You use data to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and make resource-allocation decisions. Experienced in market expansion: A track record of launching, scaling or entering new markets, assessing commercial potential and coordinating cross-functional execution in complex environments. Strong budget and investment management: Experience overseeing multi-market budgets, identifying performance gaps, reallocating investment and balancing growth ambitions with financial discipline. A partnership and distribution builder: Experience developing strategic commercial relationships, negotiating agreements and building acquisition channels that deliver measurable growth. Hands-on and execution-focused: Comfortable moving between regional strategy, financial reviews, leadership coaching and operational problem-solving. You act decisively, take ownership and thrive in a fast-moving environment. A strong cross-functional collaborator: Able to align product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other teams around shared priorities while balancing regional requirements with company-wide objectives. Adaptable across diverse markets: Comfortable operating across different customer segments, cultures, competitive environments and levels of market maturity. Experience across Asian markets or diaspora-focused businesses is an advantage. An accountable and empowering leader: You establish high standards while giving capable teams the autonomy to make decisions. You know when to coach, when to challenge and when to intervene to protect business performance. Nice to have Remittance and payments experience: Experience scaling international money transfers, cross-border payments or digital wallets, with a strong understanding of FX pricing, corridor economics and customer behaviour. Experience across Asian markets: Existing knowledge of one or more of China, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh or the Philippines, including relevant customer segments, competitive dynamics and commercial opportunities. Multi-country P&L experience: Previous responsibility for a regional business spanning multiple markets, with a demonstrated ability to balance local market ownership and regional financial objectives. Market launch experience: Experience taking new markets from initial opportunity assessment through launch and into sustainable growth. Diaspora and distribution networks: Relationships with relevant community organisations, student associations, employers, influencers and other distribution partners across key sending and receiving markets. Why join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App S

title: Staff Brand Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 <strong>London </strong>| 💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</strong> |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h4><strong>⭐ Our Design team</strong></h4> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</p> <p>Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Staff Software Engineer, Inference
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h3> <p>CoreWeave’s Inference team builds and operates the core cloud platform powering massive-scale GPU workloads for AI/ML, VFX, rendering, and real-time inference. Our stack is engineered for speed, scale, and cost efficiency—providing a powerful alternative to traditional hyperscalers where infrastructure is our core product operated at massive scale.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong> </p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer on the Inference team, you will operate as a technical leader across multiple teams and services, driving architecture, performance, and reliability for CoreWeave’s Kubernetes-native inference platform. You will define and lead complex, cross-cutting design initiatives spanning request routing, adaptive scheduling, GPU resource management, and cost-per-token optimisation under strict P99 SLAs. In this high-impact role, you will implement advanced inference optimisations—such as speculative decoding and KV-cache reuse—while establishing performance benchmarking frameworks, guiding cross-functional alignment across infrastructure boundaries, and raising the bar for engineering rigour and observability practices across the organisation.</p> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).</li> <li>8+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems or cloud platforms, with a proven track record of leading cross-team or organisation-level technical initiatives at scale.</li> <li>Strong coding proficiency in Go, Python, or C++.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Kubernetes at production scale, including orchestration, scheduling, and service design.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networked systems, performance optimisation, and distributed system design.</li> <li>Hands-on engineering experience with inference systems, including batching/micro-batching strategies, caching, memory optimisation, mixed precision (BF16/FP8), and streaming token delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to systematically improve tail latency (P95/P99) and platform reliability through metrics-driven engineering.</li> <li>Proven experience owning system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct open-source or production contributions to modern inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or TorchServe).</li> <li>Deep experience with GPU systems engineering and hardware performance optimisation (e.g., CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, NUMA, or GPU interconnects).</li> <li>Direct exposure to large-scale AI/ML infrastructure or hyperscale cloud environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams—even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to: </strong>Scale highly complex distributed architectures and mentor engineering cohorts to elevate technical standards across an organisation.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about: </strong>Pioneering low-latency inference optimisations and finding innovative shortcuts to optimise cost-per-token performance.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in: </strong>Metrics-driven engineering, troubleshooting micro-bottlenecks, and delivering stable cloud platforms under strict multi-tenant constraints.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority and communicate effectively across regions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or portals</li> <li>FinOps or cloud cost management experience</li> <li>Regulated or high-availability environment experience</li> <li>Backend development experience</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery.</p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong> just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. title: Lead Product Manager
description: About ExTrac ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with. What the job involves Roadmap ownership Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan. Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning. Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked. Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions. Discovery and definition Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs. Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility. Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve. Product operations and delivery Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow. Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments. Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan. Technical and data judgement Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics. Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders. Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction. Research, validation and data Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it. Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want. Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users. Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design. For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off. Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation. Working with AI: Co-Analyst Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need. Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses. Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations. Raising the bar for product practice Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use. Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas. Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows. Cross-functional collaboration Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery. Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions. Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication. You should apply if You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value. You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore. You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call. You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating. You find genuine satisfaction in bringing order to messy tooling and processes, because you have seen how much leverage a well-run product operation creates. You make the people around you better. You share your craft, coach colleagues, and improve the processes you work within, without needing a title that says you must. Where this role can take you Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means broader ownership, higher-stakes bets, and more direct influence over product strategy. Help define how AI-native intelligence products get built. Co-Analyst is a category-shaping product, and the work you deliver will influence how the industry approaches human-AI analytical workflows. Grow with the Product function. As ExTrac scales, this role is the natural path towards senior product leadership. Progress on either track: ExTrac values the individual contributor and Manager paths equally, so you can deepen technical scope or take on people leadership as your responsibilities grow. Requirements ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand. 4+ years in product management, ideally in AI/ML, data science, or intelligence-related fields, with a proven track record of shipping complex products from concept through to delivery. Experience delivering product work in a startup or growth-stage company, with demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end with minimal oversight. Able to translate complex technical solutions into product decisions, judging when user research should lead (usability and workflow fit) and when expertise-led conviction should (what to build), and using data and analytics as inputs rather than the whole answer. Comfortable working hand in hand with engineering and ML teams, with a good understanding of how complex ML models are integrated into user-facing products, alongside data processing and analytics. Skilled at working with engineering, ML, design, and customer success, and at synthesising input from multiple disciplines into coherent product decisions in a collaborative, agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex information clearly to executives, clients, and internal teams. Desirable Experience in threat intelligence, risk analysis, or geopolitical intelligence, or in other highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g. government, defence). Experience working within complex, data-led startups or other high-growth digital environments. A foundation in machine learning, data analytics, or AI product management, particularly integrating complex ML models into user-facing products. Interview Process We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows: Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes Craft & Competency-based Interviews - 60 Minutes x 2 Senior Executive Interview - 45 Minutes Benefits Competitive salary based on skills and experience. A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions. Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme. A sabbatical leave offer. £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays. frameworks such as Jest and Detox.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the Team Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies. We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world. About the role: As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks. This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others. What you'll be doing: Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies. Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges. Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise. Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints. Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments. Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks. Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects. Who we're looking for: You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms. You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty. You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks. You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards. You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines. You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI. Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Take Home Technical Assessment Technical Interview (90 minutes) Commercial Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
