title: Legal Solutions Engineer
description: Legal Solutions Engineer Edinburgh London Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role Legal Solutions Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers. You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates. It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform. What you’ll do Customer Implementation Lead implementation projects for new customers Design workflows and automation tailored to each organisation Configure the platform to support real legal use cases Solution Design Work directly with legal teams and Legal Ops leaders to understand how they operate Translate legal processes into structured workflows and AI-enabled automation Advise on best practices for implementing legal technology Customer Success & Expansion Support onboarding and early adoption Help customers expand into additional workflows and use cases Partner with Account Management to identify growth opportunities Product Feedback Surface patterns, insights, and recurring requests to Product and Engineering Help shape how the product evolves based on real usage What we’re looking for Experience in legal tech, legal operations, or process transformation Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work Ability to manage customer projects and guide stakeholders through change Comfortable working across legal and technical domains Structured thinker — you can turn messy processes into clear systems Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers Typical backgrounds include: Legal Engineers Legal Operations professionals Lawyers who have moved into legal tech Implementation or solutions consultants in SaaS with a legal background How we work We’re an in-office team in Edinburgh. We work together because it helps us collaborate closely across product, engineering, and customer teams. You should expect to be in the office as your default. This is a high ownership role. You’ll be trusted to run projects, work directly with customers, and drive outcomes without heavy oversight. The problems are often not fully defined. Part of the role is bringing structure and clarity to how legal work gets done. Why this role matters The value of legal technology comes from how it’s implemented. Legal Solutions Engineers ensure customers successfully embed Wordsmith into their workflows and see real impact. This role sits at the centre of that. What you can expect Direct impact on customer outcomes and product adoption Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams A chance to shape how legal teams use AI in practice Competitive salary and meaningful equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! </strong>We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k </p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. title: Graduate Sales Development Representative (London)
description: About the role Start your sales career at Pugpig, helping some of the world’s leading media brands to reach and engage their audiences. As a Graduate Sales Development Representative, you’ll be the first point of contact for prospective customers and help build a new-business pipeline across the UK, Europe and the Americas. You’ll learn how to research target accounts, start relevant conversations , qualify opportunities and work with the sales and marketing teams to turn good prospects into meetings and future customers. This is an entry-level role with support, training and the opportunity to progress into a broader sales or account management role. The role is based at our Holborn office, with at least three days per week in the office. Key responsibilities Be the first point of contact for prospective Pugpig customers, starting relevant conversations and understanding their needs Build new business pipeline across the UK, Europe and the Americas Research and prioritise target account lists, identifying the publishers and contacts most likely to benefit from Pugpig Run tailored outbound campaigns using cold calls, LinkedIn and email, adapting the message to each publisher and product Generate and qualify sales opportunities, asking useful questions and deciding which prospects should move forward Work alongside our Head of Marketing and the sales team to plan campaigns, share feedback and improve our approach Respond to inbound sales queries promptly and helpfully Support meetings, product demonstrations and industry events by researching prospects, preparing briefs, booking conversations and following up afterwards Use HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and AI prospecting tools to research accounts, run campaigns efficiently and keep learning about our customers Maintain accurate and useful records in our CRM so that the wider sales team has a clear view of every opportunity About Pugpig We’re the best mobile publishing platform on the market and we work with the world's best media companies. We work in close partnership with our customers to conceive, evolve, customise and operate our platforms, so they can focus on their core business. Our platforms power hundreds of apps for the biggest media brands in the world, including The Independent, New Scientist, The Spectator, Condé Nast, Reach, DMG Media, Hearst and many more. We work with news media, consumer magazines, B2B publishers and membership organisations. Our teams in London and New York offer deep expertise and support to customers around the world. About you You’re at the start of your sales career, or have up to two years’ experience. You’re ambitious and excited to learn how tech sales works in media and publishing. You’re confident communicating with new people, curious about their businesses and able to explain ideas clearly. You are resilient, persistent and comfortable hearing “no” while continuing to follow up professionally. You have a genuine interest in technology and can understand and explain simple technical concepts with clarity. You don’t need to have a technical degree, but you should be curious about how technology works and able to learn our products quickly. You'll become an expert in our products, services and sales process. You’re super organised, detail-oriented and motivated by progress. You take coaching well, enjoy working towards shared goals and can manage your own activity. You’ll excel at researching leads and be great at starting new relationships. You're quick to learn and pick up new skills, and you'll be able to use your creativity to overcome challenges. You have an interest in media and publishing and can understand the requirements of the buyers and end-users of our products and services. You’ll have these skills and qualities: Positive, can-do attitude Driven, keen to succeed and eager to learn Excellent communicator (both verbal and written) and team player Highly organised and uses initiative Great eye for detail Creative approach to problem solving Good understanding of technology Working at Pugpig Here are some of the things you’ll experience if you come and join us: You’ll be working with the world’s best media companies Alongside an awesome, vibrant team of technology professionals With a set of values that puts an emphasis on quality of life for all of our team members We work hybrid in central London Performance-related bonus scheme Wellbeing support and healthcare options Volunteering days every year so that you can support a charity that’s close to your heart Training and conference budgets that help you stay on the top of your game Our values Be the solution We take the initiative and seek to solve problems with creativity. Make tomorrow better We think critically about what will deliver our goals and improve tomorrow; Our future selves will thank us. Zoom out We think big picture and look beyond our immediate field of vision. Be kind We communicate with kindness, openness and respect; We approach interactions with a positive and supportive attitude. Enjoy the ride We have fun and prioritise quality of life, even when we’re up against it. If this role sounds like a great fit, get in touch with us, we’d love to hear from you! Pugpig is committed to promoting an inclusive culture. We believe that diversity leads to a happier and more productive working environment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. £64,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working approach</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter</li> <li>Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)</li> <li>Monzo behavioural interview (45 min)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3 - title: Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation
description: We're looking for an exceptional AI-native operator to join Smartly as Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation , working directly with our Chief People Officer. Smartly is a global technology company at the intersection of AI, advertising, and creativity. As AI transforms how businesses operate, we're rethinking how we organize work, build capabilities, and unlock productivity across our global organization.This is an opportunity to be at the center of that transformation. You'll help drive some of our most important strategic initiatives—from launching new R&D centers globally to building an entirely new approach to workforce planning. You'll create the operating rhythm that keeps our People leadership team aligned, accountable, and moving forward. And you'll build AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that connect information, automate processes, and help us make better decisions. We're looking for a builder, not just a coordinator. You're the kind of person who sees a messy problem, builds a plan, gets the right people moving, and then asks how AI could make the whole process 10x better. What You'll Do Drive high-impact transformation projects Own the execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives, including global expansion, workforce planning, organizational transformation, and AI-enabled ways of working. Translate ambitious priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability. Bring senior stakeholders together, unblock decisions, and ensure important initiatives move forward with urgency and discipline. Build AI-powered tools and operating systems Design and build AI agents, automations, and workflows that make our People organization more effective. Develop tools that connect People data with Finance, Operations, and business performance metrics to improve visibility into organizational effectiveness and transformation outcomes. Experiment with emerging AI technologies, prototype new solutions, and turn successful experiments into scalable workflows. Partner with technical and analytics teams to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and useful. Be the operational engine of our People leadership team Establish a consistent cadence of planning, reporting, project reviews, and accountability across our global People organization. Create dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into strategic priorities, progress, risks, and decisions. Own the preparation of quarterly People business reviews for our CEO, turning complex information into sharp insights and compelling executive presentations. Help our Chief People Officer and leadership team stay focused on the work that matters most. Who You Are An AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools—you've built agents, automations, or workflows that solve real problems. You're constantly experimenting with what's new. An exceptional operator. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless about follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks. Entrepreneurial and resourceful. You thrive in fast-moving environments, figure things out independently, and love building from scratch. Confident and people-oriented. You enjoy meeting people, asking questions, and engaging senior leaders. You're comfortable pushing for clarity and accountability. Analytical and articulate. You can turn messy information into clear thinking, compelling presentations, and actionable recommendations. Intellectually curious. You learn quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and get energized by unfamiliar problems. You likely have 2–5 years of experience in a high-growth startup, founder's office, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or a similarly demanding environment.You don't need an HR background or a traditional Chief of Staff title. We're far more interested in what you've built, how you think, and what you're capable of becoming. Why This Role? You'll work directly with the Chief People Officer on initiatives that shape how a global technology company operates. You'll gain exposure to executive decision-making, international expansion, organizational strategy, AI transformation, and the future of work—while taking real ownership from day one. You'll have the freedom to experiment, build new tools, challenge existing processes, and make a visible impact. If you're ambitious, love solving hard problems, and want to help build the operating model of an AI-native company, we'd love to hear from you. About Smartly Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers. Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it. Visit Smartly to learn more. The processing of your information is described in our Candidate Privacy Notice . Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (C++/C#)
description: The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs. Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG. We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our core engineering team. You'll be responsible for implementing and maintaining our C# client library, and also working alongside our core engineering team on the most performance-sensitive parts of our codebase. Responsibilities Own and maintain our C# client library, ensuring it is robust, well-tested, and easy for external users to integrate with. Design, develop, and maintain high-performance server applications in C++. Write message parsers and feed handlers for direct market data feeds from trading venues. Optimize existing codebase for high throughput (millions of messages per second, up to 40+ gigabits) and low latency (measured in nanoseconds). Implement tools and libraries for petabyte-scale data processing and analysis. Collaborate with the systems team to implement best practices for build, deployment, CI/CD. Implement monitoring and improve application uptime. Ensure smooth feature rollouts and updates. Preferred background 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup. Strong proficiency in both C++ and C#. Experience with Java is a plus. Experience designing APIs with a strong focus on intuitive, developer-friendly interfaces. Familiarity with open source best practices, including release management, versioning, changelogs, issue triage, and backwards compatibility. Knowledge of systems programming, algorithms, data structures, multithreading, networked I/O, serialization, CPU architecture, kernel, and compilers. Experience working with multiprocess environments. Comfortable with lldb/gdb. Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace. An interest in low-level optimization and performance engineering. An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading. We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency. The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$250,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role. Notice about phishing scams Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). title: Shared Services Manager
description: We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets. About Us M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen. The Role Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records. This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services. Why this timing matters We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it. What makes this different Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion. What You'll Do Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences. Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting. Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers. Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files. Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation. Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth. Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR. What You'll Need A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable. Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement. Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes. Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers. Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred. Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred. The reality check This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this. Why M-KOPA? At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility. Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com . Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya. Important Notice M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process. Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date. If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references. title: People Operations Manager
description: About Us At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging. We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a recognised leader in data and analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses. The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the culture, and what algo1 becomes. The Role We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on People Operations Manager to help us build and run the people side of algo1 as we grow. This is a remote, part-time role, working approximately 3-4 hours each day, five days a week. There will be the occasional need to visit our London office to meet key colleagues. You’ll report to our Chief Operating Officer and work closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business. We need someone who is equally comfortable handling the day-to-day essentials of HR administration and providing thoughtful, practical support on broader people matters. One day you might be preparing a contract, organising onboarding or updating employee records. The next, you could be helping a manager prepare for a performance review, working through a people issue or improving one of our HR processes. You’ll ideally have worked in a startup or small, fast-growing business before, so you’ll understand that there isn’t always a playbook. You’ll know when to follow a process, when to improve one, and when to use your judgement to find a pragmatic solution. This is a role for someone who enjoys getting things done, takes pride in the details and wants to make a meaningful contribution to a growing business. What You’ll Own People administration and employee lifecycle. Own the day-to-day people administration, including offer letters, employment contracts, employee records, documentation and changes throughout the employee lifecycle. Ensure everything is accurate, organised and up to date. Hiring, onboarding and off-boarding. Coordinate the operational side of bringing people into and out of the business, ensuring contracts, checks, documentation and handovers are completed smoothly and people have a positive experience. Right to work and immigration. Manage right to work checks and coordinate visa and sponsorship processes where required, maintaining accurate records and ensuring the business meets its obligations. Performance and employee relations. Coordinate performance review processes, support managers with feedback and performance conversations, and help manage employee matters with appropriate documentation, follow-up and escalation. HR guidance and compliance. Act as a first point of contact for everyday people questions, providing practical guidance to managers and employees. Maintain our people policies and processes, ensuring they remain appropriate and compliant as the business grows. People systems and reporting. Own our HR systems and people data, maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring information is accessible, reliable and well organised. Culture and people initiatives. Support employee engagement and wider people initiatives, helping to build a positive, thoughtful and high-performing working environment. Process improvement and operational support. Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve how we manage people operations. Work closely with the COO on ad hoc people and operational projects as needed. About You Must Have Relevant HR experience. You have a solid background in HR (or ‘People’) Operations, ideally in a generalist or standalone role where you’ve had broad responsibility across the employee lifecycle. Confidence using HR systems , DocuSign and spreadsheets. Strong understanding of UK employment practices. You have a good working knowledge of UK employment law, HR compliance and best practice, and understand when specialist advice is needed. Sound judgement and discretion. You’re comfortable handling sensitive and confidential matters, approaching difficult situations objectively and communicating with empathy and professionalism. A highly organised, detail-oriented approach. You’re methodical, reliable and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the details. An independent, hands-on mindset. You take ownership, use your initiative and are equally comfortable working through tasks independently as collaborating with managers and senior leadership. Clear communication skills. You’re able to build trust across different levels of an organisation and adapt your communication style to the situation. Nice to Have Startup experience. You’ve worked in an early-stage or small, fast-growing business and understand the realities of building processes while operating in an environment where priorities and structures can change quickly. Experience supporting UK visa and sponsorship processes, including Skilled Worker sponsor licence requirements. A CIPD qualification or equivalent relevant experience. Experience establishing or improving people operations in an early-stage business. An interest in using AI and automation to make people processes more efficient. How We Work We’re a fast-moving startup, and we value people who are curious, pragmatic, organised and comfortable taking ownership. There is flexibility in how those hours are structured, with a working pattern agreed together. You’ll need to be accessible during agreed UK working hours and comfortable collaborating virtually with our team. We believe great people operations don’t need to be complicated. We want someone who can bring experience and good judgement, keep the essentials running brilliantly and help us build the right processes as we grow. What We Offer Competitive salary (pro rata). 25 days’ annual leave (pro rata), plus applicable bank holidays. A predominantly remote role. A flexible, part-time working pattern across five days a week. Real ownership and the opportunity to shape our people practices. The chance to work with an ambitious team building an AI-native product from the ground up. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Designer: UX/UI
description: About Us At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging. We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a recognised leader in data and shopper analytics. Together, they have built a team of frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses. The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the culture, and what algo1 becomes. The Role You'll report to our Head of Design, who sets the overall design direction across our consumer and business applications, brand and website. You'll be our most senior hands-on product designer, owning the UX, UI and design system of our consumer applications, with significant influence over product direction. We're building something with no established design playbook: a consumer experience that connects the digital and physical worlds of grocery shopping. The challenge is that a store isn't a website. Shoppers are moving, browsing shelves and making decisions in seconds. The store must remain the main event, with our technology playing a supporting role rather than competing for attention. The hardest part is making this feel intuitive for everyone, from digitally confident shoppers to people who rarely use technology in stores. You'll need exceptional consumer mobile design skills, the curiosity to rethink familiar interaction patterns and the judgement to make sophisticated AI feel effortless. You'll work closely with product, engineering and machine learning to shape what we build, not just how it looks. You'll have the opportunity to test your ideas with real shoppers, improve existing experiences and invent new ones as we build towards scale. Success will be measured by how much easier and more engaging you make shopping, not by how many screens you design. This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't manage people initially, but you'll help hire and mentor the designers who join next, set the quality bar and establish how the team works. How you work matters as much as what you design. We're agentic-first and everyone has access to max-tier AI tools, so you'll never be rate-limited. You'll use AI throughout the design process, from exploration and prototyping to design-to-code and QA, and help us discover better ways to build. What You'll Own Consumer UX and UI. Own the quality of our mobile consumer experience, from complex journeys and interaction patterns to clear, polished, production-ready screens. Make every interaction feel simple, intuitive and consistent. Connected shopper journeys. Design experiences that move naturally between home and store. Bring digital discovery, planning and personalisation into physical shopping without distracting from the products on the shelves. Product thinking and innovation. Work with product and engineering to define problems, challenge assumptions and shape the roadmap. Invent new interaction patterns where conventional mobile UX doesn't translate to the physical world. The design system. Own the components, tokens, patterns and documentation that keep our consumer experience consistent as we scale. Keep Figma and code aligned, manage contributions and prevent design drift. Shopper research and measurable improvement. Observe and test with real shoppers across different ages, abilities and levels of digital confidence. Use usability testing, product analytics and UX audits to identify friction, prioritise improvements and measure engagement and task success. AI interaction quality. Design how AI behaves within the shopping experience: when it helps, how it communicates and when it stays out of the way. Make intelligent features understandable, useful and always under the shopper's control. Raise the design bar. Lead design QA, accessibility reviews and critique. Establish effective AI-native design workflows, mentor other designers and make sure what ships meets the quality bar. About You Must Have Exceptional consumer mobile design. You've led UX and UI design for a high-quality, complex consumer mobile product. Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding visual and interaction craft, including excellent hierarchy, layout, typography and attention to detail, alongside strong product thinking and measurable improvements to real user experiences. First-principles thinker. You challenge established UX conventions, simplify complex problems and can invent new interaction patterns when existing ones don't work. You're comfortable balancing innovation with familiarity and ease of use. Design-system ownership. You've maintained and evolved a design system in production, working closely with engineering on components, tokens, documentation, consistency and adoption. Evidence-led product thinking. You combine user research, usability testing, accessibility principles and product analytics to make better decisions. You can demonstrate how your work improved usability, engagement or other meaningful outcomes. Technical fluency. You understand modern design-to-code workflows and work effectively with front-end engineers to ensure the experience that ships matches the design intent. AI-native mindset. You actively use AI tools throughout your design process, experiment with new ways of working and know where human judgement and craft remain essential. High agency and ownership. You take responsibility from problem definition through to shipped experience, influence product decisions and maintain exceptional standards in a fast-moving environment. Nice to Have Physical-world experiences. Experience designing for retail, in-store screens, kiosks, connected devices or products that bridge digital and physical environments. Front-end development. HTML, CSS or React skills, with the ability to contribute directly to a coded design system. Product analytics. Experience with funnels, session recordings, experimentation and A/B testing. Motion and interaction design. The ability to use motion, transitions and feedback to make interfaces more intuitive. Early-stage startup experience. You've helped build a product or design practice while the company and team were growing. How We Work We’re a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you’re happiest when you’re creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you’ll fit right in. We draw our energy from being together, so this is primarily an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to be. What We Offer Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 25 days’ annual leave. The opportunity to shape a new consumer experience with the potential to reach millions of shoppers. The Retention & Loyalty team is responsible for the features and experiences that keep customers engaged with their Railcards on the Trainline app, from renewal journeys to loyalty incentives that make rail travel feel more rewarding over time. As a Mid-Level Web Engineer, you’ll work closely with product, design and data colleagues to build and improve the web experiences that support Railcard renewal and loyalty, taking ownership of your work from initial development through to release and ongoing monitoring. You’ll also help shape how the team approaches new features and experiments, contributing ideas as well as code. In this role as the Mid-Level Web Engineer, you will... 🚄 Build and ship new features and improvements to the Railcard experience on the Trainline app, using React and TypeScript to create reliable, maintainable interfaces Work with GraphQL and Node.js to connect front-end features to the services and data that power Railcard retention and loyalty Take ownership of your work across the full development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring on AWS Keep quality at the heart of everything you do, with a strong focus on testing and continuous improvement of the codebase Keep the customer at the centre of every decision, understanding how changes affect their experience Use A/B testing to explore different approaches and identify the most valuable solution for customers Collaborate with product, design and other engineering teams to deliver work that fits into the wider Trainline app We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 Good hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, and enjoy building well-tested, reliable features Experience working across the development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring Strong testing practices and a genuine focus on quality in your work Great communication skills and enjoy working within a collaborative, agile team A proactive, supportive and honest approach to working as part of a close-knit team Ideally some exposure to GraphQL, Node.js or AWS, or are keen to build experience with them A curiosity for learning new skills and approaches as technology evolves More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. title: Founding Sales (Science)
description: Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing. Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products. We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing. Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn. Role Overview We're hiring Founding Sales (Science) to win and grow enterprise customers for CurieOS across the scientific sector. This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed enterprise license. You'll sell to a specific group of buyers: scientific R&D organisations (chemicals, advanced materials, life sciences and energy). Most employ thousands of people. CurieOS is an operating system for science and engineering. Scientists and engineers give it multi-step, goal-driven instructions. CurieOS then runs literature review, atomistic simulation with Orb, data analysis, engineering design and hardware specification. BASF already licenses CurieOS for catalyst R&D in automotive emissions. Timing matters. Large R&D and engineering organisations are deciding now how agentic AI fits into their work, and interest in CurieOS from leading companies is strong. You'll convert this opportunity into enterprise contracts by building pipeline, developing strategic relationships and closing complex deals. You'll bring the experience to qualify, price, negotiate and grow enterprise platform partnerships. You'll be one of the first dedicated commercial hires for CurieOS. You'll work directly with the founders, GTM and Product teams, and our own scientists and engineers who use and build CurieOS every day. Open new customers with a focused first deployment in R&D, then expand across the business to the engineering teams that turn those materials into products. Show buyers clearly why an agentic operating system built for science and engineering does what general-purpose AI assistants cannot Run Technical Evaluations That Convert Agree pilot success criteria, owners and timelines with the customer before work begins Lead technical discovery and demos yourself, and work with our forward-deployed engineers and scientists on drive adoption Clear security and data-governance reviews, covering IP protection, data residency and model governance Set the Standard for Enterprise Sales Bring the enterprise sales discipline a fast-moving team needs: qualification, forecasting, pricing, contracting and pilot structure. Build the CurieOS sales playbook as you go Expand first deployments into multi-team and multi-site enterprise licenses Turn customer outcomes into references and case studies that shorten the next sales cycle What We’re Looking For You know the market for science technologies. Senior scientists and engineering leaders take you seriously from the first meeting. You can run discovery with a computational chemist and an engineering lead in the same week. You use AI every day in your own work. A STEM degree or scientific background is strongly preferred. Why Join Orbital Industries? Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow Flexible and generous paid time off Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Global Director of Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking, or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. We’re looking for someone to take those early learnings and build a repeatable, effective sales-led growth function for small and medium-sized businesses.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll help shape which customers we serve, where a human conversation adds the most value, and how Sales works alongside self-serve, Product, Marketing and Operations. You’ll build the team and the playbook—and stay close enough to the work to test, learn and change direction yourself.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to build an AI-native sales function from the start. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally</strong>. You’ll define our sales strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for its performance and commercial impact. That means reaching and winning the right customers, improving conversion and productivity, and building a sales motion that can grow sustainably.</li> <li><strong>You’ll work closely with RevOps, Product and other teams</strong> to help shape the targets, insights, tools and customer journeys Sales needs, and use them to guide decisions and improve results. </li> <li><strong>Build the SMB sales motion</strong>. Turn what we’re learning from our pilot into a clear strategy for the businesses we can serve best. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and <strong>identify</strong> where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.</li> <li><strong>Make growth count</strong>. Scale a sales motion that brings more high-quality business customers to Monzo, focusing investment where Sales can drive incremental growth and deliver strong returns.</li> <li><strong>Build the team</strong>. Hire, coach and develop high-performing Sales teams and Sales Managers. Set clear expectations, create a culture of learning and accountability, and Put the right team structure, incentives and ways of working in place as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Design the system around the customer</strong>. Work with RevOps, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations on targeting, lead generation, routing, sales process, reporting and forecasting. Spot where the journey breaks down and bring people together to fix it.</li> <li><strong>Make Sales and Product ‘One Team’</strong>. Share what you learn from customers and the sales funnel with Product, and work together on the experience, capabilities and product signals that help the right businesses discover and get value from Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Build an AI-native way of working.</strong> Identify and test opportunities to redesign how the team works—from finding and prioritising prospects to preparing for conversations, following up, coaching and forecasting. Work with specialist teams to put useful tools and workflows in place, measure their impact and embed the ones that work.</li> <li><strong>Use data to guide our approach</strong>. Build a clear view of the funnel, productivity, customer quality and sales economics. Use evidence to guide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.</li> <li><strong>Earn customers’ trust</strong>. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.</li> <li>You’re an experienced sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.</li> <li>You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.</li> <li>You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. You can explain the problem you were solving, what you tested, how you brought people along and what difference it made. </li> <li>You’re a practical change leader. You have experience putting practical changes into action. You can review and improve established ways of working, make progress through ambiguity and help a team adopt new approaches.</li> <li>You know how to get the best from Revenue Operations. You understand the foundations of a healthy sales engine, from lead routing and CRM to forecasting, funnel analysis and sales productivity, and know how to build them with the people who specialise in them.</li> <li>You work well with Product and other teams. You can connect what customers need and what Sales is learning to product and business decisions, and bring people together around a shared outcome.</li> <li>You’re commercially sharp. You understand the economics of growth, use data to challenge assumptions and can balance near-term results with building for the long term. You know when to keep experimenting and when to scale.</li> <li>You might have built in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get there.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong><br>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £133,900 - £175,000 ➕ equity & Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intro call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min hiring manager call</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> <li>Stakeholder chat</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products.
